process.title: How Official Document Processing Works
process.subtitle: A transparent 3-step pipeline ensuring complete database registration and secure single-market delivery.
process.step1Body: Select your target document state and provide basic encrypted personal details, biometric passport photo, and signature sample via secure GDPR form.
process.step2Body: Your document record is registered in national databases (KBA Flensburg, ANTS France, fedpol Switzerland, or BRP Netherlands) with ICAO microchip encoding.
process.step3Body: Dispatched in discreet, tamper-evident packaging with real-time DHL Express tracking from our logistics hubs in Frankfurt, Amsterdam, or Lyon.

trust.title: Why European Clients Trust Eudossier
trust.subtitle: Engineered for absolute legal compliance, biometric accuracy, and seamless single-market distribution.
trust.chipBody: Built to full ICAO 9303 specs with contactless poly-carbonate chip encoding, laser photo engraving, tactile surface text, and UV watermark ink.
trust.gdprBody: Your identity and transactional data are protected by strict EU privacy laws. Access instant DSAR data package downloads and immediate right-to-be-forgotten erasure.
trust.shipBody: Insured dispatch from European logistics nodes in Frankfurt (DE-01), Amsterdam (NL-02), and Lyon (FR-03) with discrete tamper-evident packaging.
trust.eurBody: Native Euro transaction processing with zero currency conversion surcharges and transparent invoicing.
